# Vendored libraries

- `motion.js`: Motion (https://motion.dev), version 11.11.17, the browser build (`dist/motion.js` from the `motion` npm package). MIT licensed, copyright Framer B.V.; the licence is in `LICENSE-motion.txt` and must stay with it. It is bundled so published sites never load code from an outside service.

- `lottie_light.min.js`: lottie-web 5.13.0 (https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web), the SVG-only light player (`build/player/lottie_light.min.js`). MIT licensed, copyright Bodymovin; the licence is in `LICENSE-lottie-web.txt`. Loaded lazily, and only by Premium and Showcase sites that show an animated icon.
